canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Daiis Wyror: 31-year-old man, 148 cm (very-short), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-4-medium. Face: wide triangular face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; no added facial mark. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blonde-gold, curls-coils-halo, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; rolled sleeves and one architectural lapel; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: a shaped cloth clasp; a wrapped keepsake cord; a small throat necklace. Make body construction and habitual posture the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a blunt carpenter's chalk only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
